title: Open Heart Layered Bracelet
descriptionHtml:
Two fine chains, two open hearts. Two strands joined at each end: a fine gold tone curb chain carrying two small polished beads, and beneath it a fine cable chain with two open heart outlines, each about 9mm wide, and a single bead between them. No stones, just polished gold tone that layers by itself.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone; the two strands already do the stacking.

Details

  • Strands: Two, joined at both ends
  • Upper strand: Fine curb chain with two polished gold beads
  • Lower strand: Fine cable chain with two open hearts, approximately 9mm wide, and one bead
  • Beads: Approximately 4mm
  • Stones: None
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
